title: HIT PARADE
short_description: HIT PARADE - a 3D versus fighting game staged as a late-night TV fight show. Two contestants, one condemned set, best of three rounds, and every hit plays to the crowd.
description:
LIVE ON KNOCKOUT 13.

Every Friday night an underground network takes over the airwaves with HIT PARADE, a no-rules fight show shot on condemned sets across a rotting city. Contestants sign up for money, revenge or fame. The cameras never cut away.

HIT PARADE is a 3D-rendered versus fighting game played on a single fight line, Street Fighter style: walk, dash, jump, crouch, block by holding back, and trade light, medium and heavy attacks plus a special button. Bouts are best of three rounds on a 99-second clock.

This early build of the show has two contestants:
- JOHNNY RIOT, the headliner: a boxer with a straight-ahead toolkit.
- BRUNO "THE FRIDGE": a big-bodied grappler who wants you close.

Two players share one keyboard, or each takes a gamepad.

Two control types with the same timing underneath: SIMPLE (the special button plus a direction) and CLASSIC (motion inputs).

Comic violence only: hits land with a hard freeze and a red cartoon splash, never realistic gore.
controls_keyboard: P1: W A S D move, jump (W or SPACE) and crouch; hold back to block · J light · K medium · L heavy · I special · U assist (hold) · H throw · O parry · P impact · ESC pause. P2 on the same keyboard: arrow keys · Numpad 1 / 2 / 3 light / medium / heavy · Numpad 5 special · Numpad 4 assist · Numpad 0 throw · Numpad 6 parry · Numpad + impact
controls_gamepad: Standard gamepad: left stick or d-pad move · X light · Y medium · RB heavy · A special · B assist (hold) · LT throw · LB parry · RT impact · START pause
art_direction: Key art for a late-night TV fight show, built as stylised 3D with cel-shaded characters and thick ink outlines. Two fighters square off on a condemned studio set: a lean boxer in taped fists and a sleeveless shirt throwing a straight right, and a huge slab of a grappler with a shaved head, arms wide, ready to grab. Blue-painted stone brick walls, iron-banded doors, harsh studio spotlights, a shadowy crowd behind a rope line, light haze. A red LIVE bug and a slanted yellow ratings frame suggest the broadcast without readable text. Saturated palette: ink purple-black #140d1f, signal red #ff2e4d, marquee yellow #ffd23a, cream #fff4e0. Punchy, comic energy with a motion-smear on the swing and a small cartoon impact star; no gore. No text, no logos, no ships, no pirates, no nautical props.
